name: Gemini (Google's free AI brain)
why: This is Stella's brain. She cannot think without it.
needs_human: Google makes you sign in and create the key yourself. Nobody else can do this part for you.

steps.title: Open Google AI Studio's key page
steps.you_see: A Google sign-in page if you are not signed in, then a page about API keys.
steps.do: Sign in with any Google account.

steps.title: Create a key
steps.you_see: A button to create an API key. The wording can change over time.
steps.do: Click it. If it asks you to pick a project, take the default or let it make one.

steps.title: Copy the key
steps.you_see: A long piece of text that starts with AIza or AQ.
steps.do: Click the copy icon next to it, or select it and press Ctrl+C.

format_hint: it starts with AIza or AQ. and is a long string with no spaces
after: Stella uses it automatically from now on. Free keys have limits: if she says she is asked too often, wait a minute.
if_leaked: If you ever paste this key somewhere public, make a new one on the same page and run /connect gemini again.
